newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kremlin says Yeltsin surgery preparations on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Kremlin says Yeltsin surgery preparations on schedule.

text.p: Preparations for Russian President Boris Yeltsin's heart operation are going according to plan, Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Tuesday.
Denying Russian media reports that the operation could be delayed, Yastrzhembsky told a news conference the latest tests showed that the quality of Yeltsin's blood had improved in the last week.
"Preparations for the operation are going according to plan," Yastrzhembsky said.

Russia's Ekho Moskvy radio had earlier quoted sources at the Central Clinical Hospital as saying the president's haemoglobin levels were so low that few surgeons would recommend an operation in the foreseeable future.
Yeltsin, 65, had two heart attacks last year and doctors have said they will operate in the next two months to improve the blood supply to his heart.

Yeltsin has rarely been seen in public since he was reelected for a second term on July 3. The non-stop rumour mill about the president's health has clearly annoyed the Kremlin which says Yeltsin is working at a sanatorium near Moscow.
